about: I'm a software engineer focused on development and problem solving, and I use AI as an everyday tool. I've been at C6 Bank since 2020: first on the Home Experience team, working on the home, login, investments, profile and Design System; since 2024 on the Artificial Intelligence team, leading Android for C6 Assistant.

Before that I was a team leader at Cubos, an Android instructor at Cubos Academy, and co-founded Space Rocket, where we built digital products from scratch. In college I researched strategy for simulated robot soccer and we became Latin American champions.
Beyond Android, I work with IoT, workflow automation and Docker/containers.
